collectionMethod: Official Longines SG rendered listing and linked official product pages were opened through the web browsing tool. The listing snapshot was labelled Crawled: yesterday; product page snapshots were labelled Crawled: today, yesterday, or 4 days ago. A separate live browser session and live network response could not be obtained. This is a partial snapshot check, not a current complete collection.
